The 10 most fun and broken builds in LoL Classic

What makes a build "fun" here?

In LoL Classic, items and ratios the modern game removed come back, and that lets through things that would be unthinkable today: mages that blink and delete, tanks that one-shot, assassins that appear and vanish. These are the most chaotic builds in the mode — all fun, and many legitimately strong. Open each one for items, runes, skill order and combos.

1. AP Ezreal — the nuclear ult

The classic of classics: full AP so your ultimate (Trueshot Barrage) nukes from half the screen away. Steal Barons, close fights from across the map, and poke without exposing yourself. See the AP Ezreal build →

2. Nuclear Alistar — the bull that one-shots

The Headbutt → Pulverize combo stops being just crowd control and, with Deathfire Grasp and Rabadon, starts deleting squishy mages instantly. Plus you're nearly unkillable with R active. See the AP Alistar build →

3. AP Warwick — the magic leech

Absurd jungle sustain and an uncancellable suppression on the enemy carry. With AP your Q hits and heals for more: you win any drawn-out fight. See the AP Warwick build →

4. AP Shaco — the demonic ambush

Jack in the Boxes that terrify, poison that slows and a clone that detonates with AP: you pop in, blow up two, vanish laughing. The king of early picks. See the AP Shaco build →

5. AP Master Yi — the blender

Alpha Strike scales with AP, makes you untargetable and resets on kill. With R you're an attack-speed blender chaining kills all the way to a pentakill. See the AP Master Yi build →

6. Akali AP burst — the assassin returns

Just back in the game: Gunblade core for sustain and mobility, then full AP so the marked combo deletes any squishy. Three dashes with R to enter and leave through the Twilight Shroud. See the Akali AP build →

7. AP Jax — the burst nobody expects

Your W and R lightning deal magic damage, so with AP you land a huge burst while your E makes you nearly immune to autoattacks. Scales until it deletes carries. See the AP Jax build →

8. AP Gangplank — explosive barrels

Ranged Parrrley that grants bonus gold, and barrels that, with AP, blow up a whole grouped team. Plus a global ult to join any fight on the map. See the AP Gangplank build →

9. Jungle Karthus — the death that reaches everyone

The jungle classic: you farm with Wall of Pain, and late your ultimate (Requiem) punishes the WHOLE enemy team from anywhere on the map. Dead, you keep dealing damage. See the Karthus build →

10. Veigar one-shot — infinite AP

You stack uncapped ability power and cage them in: Dark Matter + Deathfire Grasp + ult delete anyone. The more AP your target has, the more it hurts them. See the Veigar one-shot build →

Not sure which to try?

Spin the roulette and let fate assign you a champion, lane and build. Or check the mode guide if you're coming from modern LoL and want to understand the differences. And if you have a broken build we should add, let us know.
